verdict.rationale: Figma is a SaaS design platform with AI features, so an opt-out from AI model training is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack contains nothing about training-data controls, content-training settings, or opt-outs. Items on private plugins, admin tools, and AI credit allocation are adjacent controls and are not about training use of user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
